title: DECO: Decoupled Multimodal Diffusion Transformer for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation with a Plugin Tactile Adapter
abstract: arXiv:2602.05513v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Bimanual dexterous manipulation relies on integrating multimodal inputs to perform complex real-world tasks. To address the challenges of effectively combining these modalities, we propose DECO, a decoupled multimodal diffusion transformer that disentangles vision, proprioception, and tactile signals through specialized conditioning pathways, enabling structured and controllable integration of multimodal inputs, with a lightweight adapter for parameter-efficient injection of additional signals. Alongside DECO, we release DECO-50 dataset for bimanual dexterous manipulation with tactile sensing, consisting of 50 hours of data and over 5M frames, collected via teleoperation on real dual-arm robots. We train DECO on DECO-50 and conduct extensive real-world evaluation with over 2,000 robot rollouts. translated_title: DECO：解耦多模态扩散变压器用于带插件触觉适配器的双手灵巧操作
translated_abstract: 双手灵巧操作依赖于整合多模态输入以执行复杂的现实世界任务。为了应对有效结合这些模态的挑战，我们提出了DECO，一种解耦的多模态扩散变压器，通过专门的条件化路径分离视觉、本体感觉和触觉信号，实现多模态输入的结构化和可控集成，并配备一个轻量级适配器，用于参数高效地注入额外信号。除DECO外，我们还发布了DECO-50数据集，用于带触觉感知的双手灵巧操作，包含50小时数据和超过500万帧，通过真实双臂机器人上的遥操作收集。我们在DECO-50上训练DECO，并进行了超过2000次机器人实际部署的广泛真实世界评估。实验结果显示，DECO在所有任务中均达到最佳性能，平均成功率为72.25%，提升了21%。
tldr: 本文提出DECO，一种解耦多模态扩散变压器，通过分离视觉、本体感觉和触觉信号实现高效多模态集成，并配套DECO-50数据集，在真实机器人操作中取得72.25%的平均成功率，显著优于现有方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DECO, a decoupled multimodal diffusion transformer that disentangles vision, proprioception, and tactile signals for efficient multimodal integration, and releases the DECO-50 dataset, achieving a 72.25% average success rate in real robot manipulation, significantly outperforming existing methods.
